D.source: claude-sonnet-4-6 through an LLM gateway, in four calls of 22 rows, one topic area per call. Each prompt gave the correction/design definitions, a list of over-used scenarios to avoid, and a quota of harder rows: design talk after a turn that changed files or ran commands, design talk after a read-only turn, and corrections of earlier output after a text-only or read-only turn. It gave no classifier code, rule description or cue words. Each row records the tools the assistant called in its previous turn and a summary of its reply. A subagent generated, validated and deduplicated the rows against sets A, B and C, so the rule's author did not read them before scoring. No row was within a 0.75 similarity ratio of an earlier one, and the 47/41 output was trimmed to 40/40 by generation order. Committed at 0cf775d before the turn-state rule was written. The rule was frozen at 3dd6853 and scored on D once after. No label was changed.
